title: Plan
description: Root node of a test plan. Contains metadata and a default environment reference.

name.description: Human-readable name of the test plan.

description.description: Optional longer description of what this plan tests.

default_environment_id.description: Reference to the default Environment entity used when none is specified at a lower scope.

children.description: Child nodes (scenarios, data sources, environment bindings).

thresholds.description: Pass/fail criteria (k6 thresholds). A failed threshold marks the run's thresholds as failed; abort_on_fail ends the run early.

metric.description: k6 metric, optionally with a tag filter, e.g. http_req_duration{group:::Checkout}.

condition.description: k6 threshold expression, e.g. rate<0.05 or p(95)<500.
